Daily Transit Brief — 2026-09-23 (Wednesday)

Posted by @UngalSoththu at ~09:05 IST. Thread URL: https://x.com/ungalsoththu/status/2102603445584748681

Items (4)

  1. [CMRL] Phase-2's first stretch — Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani, 14.64 km, 11 elevated stations (Corridor 4) — CRS safety clearance received ~7 months ago (provisional Feb 2026, full clearance May 2026), still closed awaiting a PM inauguration date. — Times of India (U Tejonmayam), Sep 22, 2026. https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/chennai-metro-phase-2-inauguration-awaits-pm-modis-confirmation/articleshow/134418462.cms
  2. [CUMTA] CUMTA plans a Special Purpose Vehicle to run its auto/cab ride-hailing app: PPP model, tender doc with TNIDB, drivers as shareholders, CUMTA retains a small per-ride cut for driver welfare; digital meters; launch target June–July 2027. — DT Next (Arun Prasath), Sep 23, 2026. https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/cumta-plans-special-purpose-vehicle-to-run-ride-hailing-app-for-autos-cab
  3. [NHAI] 23 km, six-lane elevated corridor Mahindra City–Kilambakkam designed "Metro-ready" — NHAI builds the road first with metro-ready pillars; a metro infrastructure agency would later install girders, tracks, electrification; toll plaza planned; sized for 30-year traffic. — Times of India (Omjasvin M D), Sep 22, 2026. https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/chennais-new-elevated-road-may-get-a-metro-above-it-23km-corridor-from-mahindra-city-to-kilambakkam-planned-with-future-metro-and-30-year-traffic-needs-in-mind/photostory/134409434.cms
  4. [GCTP] Traffic changes on OMR (Rajiv Gandhi Salai) & Thuraipakkam effective Sep 23: U-turns pushed to Perungudi toll plaza (from Mettukuppam/Pillaiyar Koil St toward Sholinganallur; from 200ft radial road via Srivaram; U-turn ban near World Trade Centre for Kandanchavadi→SRP Tools). — ABP Nadu (Tamil), Sep 23, 2026, sourcing Greater Chennai Traffic Police (Sep 22). https://tamil.abplive.com/news/tamil-nadu/traffic-changes-will-be-implemented-from-september-23-in-the-rajiv-gandhi-salai-omr-and-thuraipakkam-area-275358
